scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix backend run openapi:bundle && npm run check:contract && npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.deploy:dev:seed: docker compose -f deploy/dev/docker-compose.yml --profile tools run --rm seed
scripts.deploy:dev:reset: docker compose -f deploy/dev/docker-compose.yml --profile tools run --rm reset
scripts.deploy:prod:up: docker compose -f deploy/prod/database/docker-compose.yml up -d --build && docker compose -f deploy/prod/backend/docker-compose.yml up -d --build && docker compose -f deploy/prod/frontend/docker-compose.yml up -d --build
scripts.deploy:prod:down: docker compose -f deploy/prod/frontend/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose -f deploy/prod/backend/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose -f deploy/prod/database/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.deploy:prod:ps: docker compose -f deploy/prod/database/docker-compose.yml ps && docker compose -f deploy/prod/backend/docker-compose.yml ps && docker compose -f deploy/prod/frontend/docker-compose.yml ps
